name: Roku, Inc.
moat_justification: Leading TV operating system in the US (~37% share, ~100M households) with home-screen gatekeeper economics and a high-margin platform (advertising + subscriptions) on top, but no owned must-have content, rival OSes from Amazon/Google/Samsung/Apple that can subsidize distribution, cyclical ad exposure, and SBC still large enough to dilute 3.1%/yr. Moderate moat, not wide.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 3.1%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
LOW_OE_YIELD: base OE yield 1.6% — valuation rests almost entirely on growth; tier is fragile
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 6.2x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: Profitability-inflecting CTV platform leader, moat 6/10 — standalone DCF does not clear 15% even on generous operating-leverage growth (weighted IRR 7.26%, IV@15 $49.95 vs $154.57 price); the price is a Fox-merger price, not standalone value — it clears 15% only at or below the weighted IV@15 of $49.95.
moat_for: #1 TV OS in the US (~37% share) reaching ~100M households — home-screen gatekeeper for discovery and advertising
Platform mix is the profit engine: high-margin advertising and subscription revenue; devices are distribution, not the business
The Roku Channel engagement plus first-party viewing data for ad targeting and measurement
Asset-light model — capex is negligible against operating cash flow in the filed history
moat_against: Amazon, Google, Samsung and Apple all ship rival TV operating systems and can subsidize hardware and defaults
No owned must-have content — The Roku Channel largely aggregates other owners' programming
Advertising revenue is cyclical and platform mix shifts pressure gross margin
SBC was $328,038,000 TTM — share count still growing 3.1%/yr despite buybacks
Pending Fox acquisition (DOJ second request, Sept 2026) makes standalone economics secondary until the deal closes or breaks
